CKKS functional bootstrapping of a Fourier series

Source: R/functional-bootstrapping.R
eval_fe_func_bootstrap_setup.Rd

Refreshes a ciphertext and evaluates on its values the function whose Fourier coefficients are coefficients, in the same step (CKKS with CKKSDataType$COMPLEX).

Usage

eval_fe_func_bootstrap_setup(
  cc,
  level_budget = c(5L, 4L),
  dim1 = c(0L, 0L),
  slots = 0L
)

eval_fe_func_bootstrap(ct, coefficients)

eval_fe_func_bootstrap_precompute(ct, coefficients)

eval_fe_func_bootstrap_with_precomp(powers, coefficients)

Arguments

cc

A CKKS CryptoContext with Feature$FHE enabled.

level_budget

Integer vector of length 2. Default c(5L, 4L).

dim1

Integer vector of length 2. Default c(0L, 0L).

slots

Integer; number of slots, 0L (default) for full packing.

ct

A Ciphertext.

coefficients

Numeric or complex vector of Fourier coefficients.

powers

A SeriesPowers object from eval_fe_func_bootstrap_precompute().

Value

eval_fe_func_bootstrap_setup(): cc, invisibly. eval_fe_func_bootstrap_precompute(): a SeriesPowers object. The others: a Ciphertext.

Details

eval_fe_func_bootstrap_setup() prepares the context; call eval_bootstrap_key_gen() after it. eval_fe_func_bootstrap() does the whole evaluation. eval_fe_func_bootstrap_precompute() and eval_fe_func_bootstrap_with_precomp() split it, so that several series of the same length can be evaluated on one input.

The setup shares the bootstrapping precomputation of the context for slots with eval_bootstrap_setup() and eval_fbt_setup(): a context holds one of the three per slot count.

See also

get_fefbt_depth()
